newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish industrial climate improves in January.
newsitem.headline: Polish industrial climate improves in January.

text.p: Poland's industrial climate in the manufacturing sector improved in January with most favourable expectations in large companies and public sector firms, the Central Statistics Office (GUS) said on Friday.
In its monthly survey GUS said the industrial climate index rose to 13 points in January from one point in December and forecasts for upcoming months were better than last month.
It said the construction sector climate index rose four percent in January to negative 11 points, stopping a seven month down trend.
BUSINESS OUTLOOK JAN DEC NOV OCT SEP JAN 95
NOTE: The indicator is a percentage balance between positive and negative responses from polled companies. Preliminary data marked (*).
